[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/b2e47fb025c8a902bfd036ae77b97e8019581eed.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]TOP 5 Bugs-That-Are-No-Bugs in Star Birds. And How to Fix Them Anyway.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Some of the most frequently reported “bugs” in the game aren’t actually bugs at all. The good news: [b]you don’t need to wait for a fix — you can keep playing[/b] right away, and in this article we’ll show you how![/p][p][/p][h2]TOP 5 Bugs-That-Are-No-Bugs[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]1. "I'm unable to connect pipes / power cables to the Excavation Hub!"[/b][/h3][p][u][b]What you report:[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Power cables from nuclear reactors or supply lines cannot be attached to the Excavation Hub.[/p][/*][*][p]Resources like water, light alloy, strong alloy, or refined materials get stuck in pipes / are not accepted by the Excavation Hub.[/p][/*][*][p]Progress quests requiring a lot of power or specific material delivery do not update even when the Excavation Hub is visibly supplied.[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]The solution:[/b][/u][/p][p]Before you get started, make sure to [b]accept the quest from Ruth[/b] — you won’t be able to connect anything to the Hub before you accept the quest. In Sector 5, you’ll then discover [b]multiple strange objects[/b]. Be sure to deliver your resources to the correct Hub, as each one demands different materials.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/817639ce44b5c35b3a3849e2864f144ea9091cae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. "I'm unable to place a Crucible / other required building in a small crater!"[/b][/h3][p][u][b]What you report:[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]The game shows small craters, but they are not recognized as valid build spots.[/p][/*][*][p]Craters generate on elevated plateaus or ridges, making them inaccessible.[/p][/*][*][p]The small explosive used up all your Strange Points, now it's impossible to create artificial craters anywhere else.[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]The solution:[/b][/u][/p][p]First, connect the [b]plateaus with a Ramp[/b] — only then can you start building on them. If the Ramp isn't available yet, you can't access them at all and need to [b]rely on the artificial craters created from Small Explosives[/b]. If you create the artificial crater at a wrong spot by accident, you can always [b]recall the artificial crater to refund the Strange Point[/b] it required.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/2f0aa9bf1a5a5db309111277efbb4c4b39a6783f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. "Resources delivered to the Station are not counted toward quest objectives!"[/b][/h3][p][u][b]What you report:[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]The Station display shows that resources are being received, but the quest counter remains stuck at 0.[/p][/*][*][p]Reloading, restarting, or re-supplying does not fix the problem.[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]The solution:[/b][/u][/p][p]You are probably working on an [b]excavation quest[/b]. If so: Deliver the resources to the [b]Excavation Hub[/b], not to the Station.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/843452f725d6def46a035e62633909cbddf84202.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. "Module quests request resources that are not accessible at the current stage!"[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][u][b]What you report:[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Required deposits may not spawn at all, or they appear only on higher plateaus that can’t be reached.[/p][/*][*][p]This creates a hard lock, since glass or other refined materials cannot be produced.[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]The solution:[/b][/u][/p][p]Module quests will keep asking for new resources for every new module, no matter if certain buildings (like Ramp or Ice Extractor) have been unlocked yet. If you're stuck at module quests that you can't fulfill, [b]follow the goal quests[/b] or [b]research missing buildings[/b] first.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/c9fb76edf36a74177622945697a53082a411e18e.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]5. "Research is stuck!”[/b][/h3][p][u][b]What you report:[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Research does not complete automatically over time.[/p][/*][*][p]Research is stuck or bugged.[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]The solution:[/b][/u][/p][p]You probably mixed up quest progress with a time-based research. As all other quests, the research of building only progresses if you [b]deliver the[/b] [b]requested resources to your Station[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/2c601dd14d7aca340ed49025731dc9a8fab98dd6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Even if these "bugs" are not bugs, your reports are still incredibly valuable. They highlight where our instructions aren’t clear enough and where the game should feel more intuitive. We’ll continue improving those points in future updates. Until then, feel free to share this article with other players and help each other out of these supposed softlocks. 🐞🐛[/p][p]

notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/a881187431fd02ba9242aae6e20f13a4a4136305.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][p][/p][p][b]☀️[/b] Fixes & Improvements Based on Community Feedback[/p][p][/p][h3]Bugfixes:[/h3][list][*][p]☀️ Fixed an issue where the game would consume excessive memory and freeze when paused and left running for an extended period.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ Fixed a bug where quickly placing a launchpad while moving the mouse could cause the placement to fail while still subtracting tech points and credits. This could lead to softlocks and occurred more frequently on lower-FPS PCs and Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ [b]Sector 03.1:[/b] Fixed ceramic not displaying a recipe in the wiki when playing this sector before Sector 04.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ Fixed audio clips cutting off prematurely when fast-forwarding game speed.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ Fixed custom key rebinds only initializing after opening the rebinding screen instead of loading automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the rebind button not reverting to its default label when starting a different rebind process, which effectively canceled the current one.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ Added a stick deadzone to prevent drifting on connected gamepads, which caused the asteroid to keep rotating.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ Fixed the "Edge Rotation Enabled" setting reverting to its default value after restarting the game.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Achievements:[/h3][list][*][p]☀️ Added a progress bar for most achievements — either counting down (e.g., for the Space Falcon challenge) or counting up.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ Disabled "Achievement Missed" notifications if the achievement has already been unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a “missed” visual state (semi-transparent) to achievement badges.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ [b]Sector 05:[/b] Improved consistency of Hard Melting remaining ice area calculation. (Note: Ice can still spawn under craters, preventing the achievement from triggering — check the progress bar to confirm.)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other Improvements:[/h3][list][*][p]☀️ Implemented autosave at fixed intervals: the game now saves automatically when switching scenes if 3 minutes have passed, and after 6 minutes if staying in the same scene. This can be disabled in the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ Added descriptions to most resource and building wiki entries.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ Improved performance when drawing very long rover paths.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ When syncing game data with Steam Cloud, the game no longer considers it a first launch on a new PC (which would play the prologue cutscene and restart Level 01) if save data already exists.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ [b]Sector 01:[/b] Stats screen and score tooltip are now accessible before completing the sector.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sector 01:[/b] The Intro cutscene no longer plays every time  when restarting the sector after completing it once.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sector 05:[/b] Removed inaccessible small craters from plateaus to avoid confusion.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ Rover no longer moves while the game is paused.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ Added a game resolution setting to the cutscene skip menu.[/p][/*][*][p]☀️ When a Strangelet is excavated (last excavation quest fulfilled), it now disappears from the asteroid and the excavation hub performing the excavation is destroyed, making it clear that the hub is no longer active.[/p][/*][*][p]Pause the cutscene playback while the cutscene skip menu is open.[/p][/*][*][p]Added social buttons to the credits screen for kurzgesagt’s Bluesky and TikTok profiles.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]The best place to give feedback is our [url="https://discord.gg/toukana"]Discord server[/url]. There, we are running a Smart Ticketing System: Leave feedback, vote up change requests and bug reports from other users, and help us to prioritize tasks in the further development of Star Birds. [/p][p][/p][p] 🙏Thank you so much everyone for the overwhelming response, all your feedback, comments and bug reports! This helps us a lot to prioritize and identify issues with the game. We're trying to address the most critical issues as soon as we can. Please be patient though, since we're a small team and might take a while to address specific issues you're experiencing!🙏 [/p]

notes.title: Early Access Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[p][b]Star Birds will be available in Early Access. Playable for everyone on Sept 10th, 2025.[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/296141a27ffa37a4dc99bac23c928b1088e63926.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re thrilled to officially announce it: [b]Star Birds will launch in Early Access on September [/b][strike]4[/strike][b] 10, 2025! [strike]
[/strike]* We've moved the release date to the 10th of September because of Silksong - read more [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2719750/view/538863491448046148"]here.[/url][/p][p]Mark your calendars – in just a few weeks you’ll be able to take off into the colorful, chaotic universe of Star Birds and see where the mission will take you.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Thank You for Shaping Star Birds[/b][/h2][p]Back in June, we released the Star Birds demo – and the response from all of you was incredible.
Your feedback has been invaluable in making the Early Access version the best it can be. You reported bugs, you shared your ideas for what you’d love to see in the game, and you helped us refine both the small details and the bigger gameplay features.
[/p][p]From the whole team: [b]thank you for being such an active and constructive part of this journey.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]FAQ – Everything You’re Asking About Early Access[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]1. Can I Play on My Mac / My Phone / My Console / My Quantum Computer? 💻[/b][/p][p]Early Access will launch on PC in all the languages already available in the demo. Other platforms are not off the table, but as a small indie team we need to stay focused and work step-by-step to deliver the highest quality possible. We’ll explore other platforms after the full release.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2. Will Star Birds Become More Complex? 🤓[/b] [/p][p]Compared to the demo, Early Access goes beyond the initial tutorial levels and steps up the complexity. At launch, you’ll be able to play more levels, build more and complex buildings, energy networks and explore many more asteroids. The Early Access release version also adds a second Star System with a bunch of new levels and even more cutscenes. In the new star system things get cold and frosty, so your birds will have to buckle up![/p][p][/p][p][b]3. Will Star Birds Cost Under 10 Euros / Over 40 Dollars / More Than Lying in the Grass and Gazing at the Starry Sky? 💰[/b][/p][p]We don’t have a final price to share yet. We know this is an important factor for many of you, and we’re working to find the right sweet spot – making Star Birds as accessible as possible for players while ensuring an appropriate value proposition. We’ll share more as soon as we have something concrete.[/p][p][/p][p][b]4. Can I Play Before September [/b][strike]4[/strike][b] 10? 😍[/b][/p][p]Yes! (Wait ... WHAT?! 🤯) If you’re at gamescom this week, we have a fresh new build of the Early Access version ready for you to try out. Stop by the Indie Arena Booth Hall 10.2 at Booth 48, say hi, play Star Birds and give our gacha machine a spin – we’d love to meet you, plus we have lots of goodies to win![/p][p][/p][p][b]5. Will Steve, the Voice of kurzgesagt Be in the Game?🔊[/b][/p][p]The question that has kept you all awake ... All clear, everybody! You can breathe easy. We’ve asked Steve to voice text some lines for Star Birds, so you can look forward to hearing the kurzgesagt narrator in the game for certain moments and selected scenes. [/p][p][/p][p]It’s been amazing to see such a constructive, helpful, friendly, and open community forming around Star Birds. Working at lightspeed on the Early Access version is twice as fun when we know we’re building it for such an awesome group of players. Here’s to the countdown for [strike]September 4[/strike] [b]September 10[/b] – and to all the adventures ahead! ✨[/p][p]    [/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]Wishlist Star Birds & Join Our Newsletter[/h3][p][i]Star Birds is an indie project by [b]Toukana Interactive[/b] and [b]kurzgesagt[/b]. We are over the moon to have such an amazing community. You are the reason why this project exists. If you want to support us, [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719750/Star_Birds/"]Wishlist [/url][/b]the game here on Steam, and tell your friends about it.

notes.title: "Games Forged in Germany" Steam Event
notes.notes:
[p][b]We’re Part of the [i]Games Forged in Germany[/i] Steam Event![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/5329c7179060aac98351023659760749671a0423.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that we’re participating in this year’s [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"][b]Games Forged in Germany Steam event[/b][/url] – a celebration of the diversity and creativity of games made in Germany, hosted by [b]Games Germany[/b], the alliance of regional funding and network institutions from across the country.[/p][p]Alongside a curated showcase event, the Steam sale highlights innovative titles from German developers and studios – and we’re glad to be part of it![/p][p][/p][h1][b]Our Games in the Spotlight: Dorfromantik & Star Birds[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]We’re showing off our own two projects during the event:[/p][p][/p][p]🌳 [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1455840/Dorfromantik/"]Dorfromantik[/url][/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1455840/Dorfromantik/"] [/url]– a peaceful building strategy and puzzle game where you lay down beautifully drawn hexagonal tiles to grow your own idyllic village landscape. Explore charming biomes, unlock new tiles, and complete quests that bring your world to life. Originally developed as a student project, Dorfromantik has become a beloved indie title worldwide.[/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/fc3ef0607a3ddff985ff5584dbb475b893482cd0.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/dfb01f4f2006fa7da26d5cbc0dd21a2fb6464857.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/3a02cf758635479a91f9295e22f0d0ff11d0760d.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]🪐 [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719750/Star_Birds/"]Star Birds[/url][/b] – our upcoming asteroid base-builder where you guide a colony of spacefaring birds through the stars! Harvest resources, build sprawling industrial networks, and relax into a rhythm of exploration and creativity. Star Birds combines chill vibes with strategic depth – all wrapped in cosmic charm.[/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/1c84cfe57f56d02fb4b5ee6ebe3757c4bbc04b8f.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/fe25bbd7af01190d82dd93f12bc2b6b35dc6771b.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/c05422966e29f8eebbcf49ca7b54cc1256109b44.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][h1][b]Celebrating the German Game Scene[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][b]We’re far from alone in this – Germany is home to a vibrant, supportive, and growing game development ecosystem. Here are just a few players we admire and want to highlight:[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Medienboard Berlin-Brandenburg[/b][/h3][p]A fantastic funding partner that supported [i]Dorfromantik[/i] from its early days. What makes their funding model so special? Developers only repay if their game becomes a success – a fair and supportive approach that encourages creativity without stifling risk-taking. Their commitment to nurturing talent has had a real impact on our journey.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]game – The German Games Industry Association[/b][/h3][p]The backbone of the German games industry, [i]game[/i] is a crucial voice for developers, publishers, and players alike. From policy advocacy to business support and networking, their work ensures the German games scene continues to thrive. As members, we’re grateful for their dedication and for always being approachable and open.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]HTW Berlin and Germany’s Tuition-Free Game Education[/b][/h3][p]It’s easy to forget just how special it is that you can study Game Design – and other creative disciplines – tuition-free in Germany. Institutions like our home university [b][url="https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/"]HTW Berlin[/url][/b] are shaping the next generation of game creators and proving how powerful public education can be for the creative industries.[/p][h3][/h3][p]... speaking of ...[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Noteworthy German Indie Studios[/b][/h3][p]We’d love to highlight some incredible German developer projects that we truly admire—starting with [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624140/Wanderburg/?utm_campaign=ggtoukana"]WANDERBURG[/url][/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624140/Wanderburg/"] [/url]and the fantastic team at Randwerk. This is one of the most exciting indie projects we’ve seen in a long time. Wanderburg is a minimalist open-world roguelike set in a fascinating ecosystem of castles on wheels. Consume, grow bigger, upgrade your modules, and survive! Unlock new weapons, build your castle, and explore a procedurally generated map filled with opportunity and danger. It’s bold, fresh, and full of style.[/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/9f93800fa5fd30f1e9fd117b0e1c589fa8d1f4b7.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/c3dd05e5f642f48e48d0680bb10bdddd24487ee7.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/0502131b197195cd2c7960c7ab0f4f9ae8e7fbb0.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]Another game close to our hearts is [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2239150/Thronefall/?utm_campaign=ggtoukana"]Thronefall[/url][/b], a minimalist game about building and defending your little kingdom. GrizzlyGames stripped a classic strategy game from all unnecessary complexity, combining it with some healthy hack and slay. In Thronefall, you build up your base during the day, and defend it til your last breath at night.[/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/d10e8931810f2f4638637f046d49d0d2678fdcb8.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/59cc57381b3afe3b5481e6f791e38315a6ff344c.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/ab451f70d654ff398f5db5ea8ea5f626d6d869e4.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]From the creator of SUMMERHOUSE comes the brand new game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3631290/?utm_campaign=starbirds"][b]SLOTS & DAGGERS[/b][/url] - a compact retro-fantasy roguelike where battles play out on a slot machine. Arm yourself to the teeth and set out on an adventure across strange and dangerous lands, where every spin could be your last![/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/b4ad2ad6f8144f6cd75e641d10b74458fe9d189e.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/0785e6729069337f803ba0df8deb74e04427e890.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/af0d29343f56482556abe2d9fc3453cc3ab351db.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]Next up is [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1737870/REKA/?utm_campaign=ggtoukana"]REKA[/url][/b], a cozy and atmospheric witchcraft adventure. Build your chicken-legged hut, gather herbs in autumnal forests, and uncover the mysteries of Baba Jaga. We’re especially excited to follow this one—not least because the team studied at HTW Berlin, just like we did.[/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/06236314cab9d2f312dc6c5bfa9d2b1eb83fe6fe.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/9841d41c30b4efc61706cd0ee72a987eb9914d96.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/8f6d70c6dc9591fd0236b8a1b0511b7d75bc3a07.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]For the automation fans in our community, we'd like to recommend shapez. shapez is a minimalistic factory building game about the automation of shapes through extraction and satisfying production lines. Last August, the successor, [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2162800/shapez_2/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=starbirds_steamnews&utm_campaign=StarBirdsCollab"]shapez 2[/url][/b], was released. With the second part of shapez, you get the chance to build huge space factories. Tackle increasingly complex automation challenges at your own pace – you won’t have to worry about enemies.[/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/e59bff9b58d200754b160282c75d85859d7a73d5.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/954e316095132942ce989a0b898717675d7bb855.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/7f38f615fc26e0f1b52bb237303a6eb24b3038e5.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]Our fellow-developers of Gentle Troll Entertainment introduce us to the world of Tavern Talk. A cozy visual novel about running a tavern in a Dungeon and Dragon-inspired fantasy. New up in the universe is the title [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3500880/Tavern_Talk_Stories_Dreamwalker/?utm_campaign=ggtoukana&snr=2___"][b]Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker[/b][/url]. Meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares.[/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//39260149/daa93db00e1769164d36bf5451457df5697b8f53.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//39260149/1194e95f3464fc14e38d95e4b27106b8055fc137.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//39260149/f5939fbdbb3aba13563633a1063885b1fac59b86.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]And finally, [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2545360/Lonely_Mountains_Snow_Riders/?utm_campaign=ggtoukana"]Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders[/url][/b], the thrilling follow-up to Lonely Mountains: Downhill by Megagon. Crash again and again until you master the mountain. Now with 2–8 player cross-platform multiplayer: descend the slopes together or go all-out in a race to the base. Fast, fun, and beautifully chaotic.[/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/24f7ca6547562d74b454bf175bc47dc048250d95.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/dc36fd079ef0c8295047b1b20c1a82acba81a042.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/5028ba35c320966f4b991797d03c7527d28a97ff.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h1][b]What is Games Germany?[/b][/h1][p][b]Games Germany – Regional Funds and Networks[/b] is a unique cooperation between 12 regional institutions – six funding bodies and six industry networks. Due to Germany’s federal system, these institutions operate locally, but under the Games Germany umbrella, they come together with a shared goal: to strengthen and showcase the national games industry. [/p][p][/p][p]For the past four years, they’ve been organizing a recurring Steam event featuring local players from our neighborhood. We’re excited to be part of it and to celebrate friends and partners we've known since our university days and the early years of Toukana. Companions on our journey, creative minds, and fantastic game makers. Check it out! 💛[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Wishlist Star Birds & Join Our Newsletter[/h3][p][i]Star Birds is an indie project by [b]Toukana Interactive[/b] and [b]kurzgesagt[/b]. notes.notes: [p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/a7fdb98eb10b243cc0f1070ba7c1c578396c7a5a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]We have received a confirmation for our Star Birds Booth at Gamescom 2025. 🎉  [/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Booth Conception[/h3][p]The confirmation for the Indie Arena is fantastic news — we're absolutely thrilled! Now it's full steam ahead with building our booth for Gamescom. What you can look forward to: [/p][list][*][p]💻 [b]Play Star Birds[/b] - We want to set up plenty of playing stations at the booth so that as many of you as possible can get a first-hand impression.[/p][/*][*][p]👩‍🔧👨‍🔬 [b]Talk to the devs & team[/b] - ask your questions about the game and have a look behind the scenes![/p][/*][*][p] 🪐 [b]Take photos[/b] with a totally real Star Birds asteroid (almost).[/p][/*][*][p]🧸 [b]Get merch and win prizes[/b] - We're preparing spaced out items for you – get ready for bags, stickers, and more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Gamescom Bag Sample: Unpacking![/h3][p]In the coming weeks we will order material, find partners, organize furniture and build props. If you feel like it, we'll take you behind the scenes in our Eventlog from time to time and report on how things are progressing with our Gamescom Booth. For once, we're not talking about code lines and an intuitive UI, but about the fitting saw blade, miniature construction and the right LED lighting. notes.title: Devlog: Crew Love Is True Love
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/a820122e7ace28ec52043cc5c36278ff0e7a9291.png[/img]


[b]Today we want to introduce you to the crew. To the birds that populate the space station in Star Birds. We show you how we came up with a strong cast of characters, and how we brought the kurzgesagt birbs to a 3D universe. And not to forget their roles on board - as we will send them on a mysterious mission ...[/b]

[h3]Getting Dressed for Space 👩‍🚀[/h3]
Sure - a game called Star Birds needs spacefaring birds. Cheerful supporting characters who lead you through the story, in dialogues and campaigns. But how to recruit them? 

As a first step, we analyzed the [b]birds that we discovered in the YouTube videos together with our project partner kurzgesagt[/b]. Their body parts, their emotions, their animations. We were looking for an elegant way to equip them for their space mission. By replacing the head feathers with accessories such as pilot's caps, and their body plumage with space suits.

[h3]Modular Bird Generation 🦉[/h3]
The next challenge was to send the 2D YouTube birds to a universe where they will become the main act of various dialogue scenes and the quest givers for the delivery missions. To do so, our teams (Toukana🤝kurzgesagt) had to create a skeleton that could be animated in our game. In Blender, we converted the SVG Vector graphics into flat mesh shapes, attached them to the skeleton and a rig and now ... they're alive! 

Finally, we added gradients and a splash of color in Unity. It was important for us to think about variation of the birds in a modular way. Easily swapping body types, shapes and colors. Internally, we call our tool the "[b]2D Bird Generator[/b]".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/e4bfd1ccb37fd301d397ed5cf706e25be61d1d7e.png[/img]

[h3]Creating Interesting Characters 🐔[/h3]
As you will not control and play your own bird character in Star Birds, but take on a managing role, our teams had to double down on the birds supporting the gameplay and narrative, leading you through the story. One of the most difficult questions was where in the game we wanted the [b]kurzgesagt birds [/b]to appear, and where the gameplay should stand on its own.

To make the gameplay and narrative fit together, we imagined them as main charaters of the cutscenes and dialogues, operators of the buildings and machinery and quest givers. To make them interesting characters, we gave them specific professions as Scientists or Engineers, Workers, and of course last but not least - a Captain to keep every member of the crew focused on the mission... in theory ;)

You can look forward to seeing the result in Star Birds soon and meeting the bird crew! Fully clothed and commissioned. 🚀

notes.title: Devlog: Resources in Star Birds
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/ee3271487e1da04803a5e3a028584662cd770365.png[/img]

[b]Today, we're excited to unveil the first hint of cosmic bounty the solar system in Star Birds has to offer! We've cooked up our own unique "ingredient list" for the universe, packed with both familiar and fantastical resources, all wrapped in a vibrant, clean design to make gathering materials a blast.[/b]

[h3]Cosmic Cookbook - Our Recipe for Resources 🚀[/h3]
If you've ever enjoyed tinkering with building blocks, mixing potions or finding interesting item combinations, you'd have loved our initial resource brainstorm! We started with the plausible basics you'd expect to find on asteroids and in space. Then, we let our imaginations run wild, adding some truly unique "spice" to the mix. We experimented with wild combos, figuring out what awesome new materials your Star Bird colony could whip up. 

The result? A sprawling catalog of metals, gases, and even some completely made-up substances, all waiting to be discovered on asteroid surfaces and transformed into essential goodies for your thriving intergalactic bird colony.

notes.title: Devlog: The Music of Star Birds
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/93e830c448ddc2dc6fadebaf72c4b25cedc80185.png[/img]

[b]For Star Birds, we are now at a point where we are creating music and sound. Which recurring theme accompanies the player? What does the space factory sound like? Let us take you on an audiovisual journey of space and sound.[/b]

[h3]Tracks: Avoiding Ear Fatigue 👂[/h3]
We think that music can have a big impact on the long-term playability of a game. It should be a homecoming, create an unobtrusive atmosphere, and convince with subtle beauty and variation. 

The music in Star Birds is supposed to have a distinct character and welcome players to a familiar "universe" at every launch. Even after many hours, we need to avoid ear fatigue. It’s the smooth transitions and soft changes in dynamics which build a foundation for the game-feel and mood.

For us, sounds fulfill at least three functions in the game: First and foremost, sounds define the atmosphere and style of a game. Second, they give feedback or confirmation for successful player actions (e.g. hovering over a button, placing a building or plugging in pipes). And finally, sounds are crucial as alert signals - warning players or helping them react to events. They are supporting visual cues.

notes.title: Devlog: The Star Map
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/0dc8ab7a8c2621776433157eb3076062f932f389.png[/img]


[b]The Star Map is an important game element in Star Birds. In each System you explore, it gives you an overview over many procedurally generated 3D asteroids, which you connect with rocket transportation routes. As players you will also be switching from asteroid surface to the map view and back, which we’re aiming for to be smooth and seamless - not an easy task![/b]

[h3]Creating a 3D Star System 🌔[/h3]
When you imagine creating your own star system, you probably expect a fulminant Big Bang. Reality is that the process begins with a set of rather pragmatic questions: What color is the universe? Is our star system flat? And if not (which is more in line with our world view): Can you seamlessly zoom out from a single asteroid to the Star Map? 

In the end, we opted for 3D objects but a 2D look – in line with the game’s artstyle so far, and kurzgesagt’s video animations.

notes.title: Devlog: Wrap Asteroids in Pipes!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/4acc6ff98b2f31c4a58545d6031343e77ba680fa.png[/img]

[h3]The Pipe Network 🍝[/h3]

[b]Star Birds[/b] is a [b]cozy factory builder[/b]. You [b]place buildings[/b] across an asteroid and [b]connect them with pipes[/b]. The pipes have an iconic transparent look, and the drawing mechanic is free-handed -  just like drawing with a brush, married with the elegance of dragging a garden hose around.

[h3]Bye to the Rigid Grid: Go with the Flow 🧶 [/h3]

When you develop a factory builder, one central question is: How do you get [b]raw materials[/b] from one building to the next? At the beginning, we considered having conveyor belts. However, a rigid building grid did not feel wholesome, so we decided for [b]flexible pipes[/b] instead. We sifted through the wonderful content library of our project partner [b]kurzgesagt - in a nutshell[/b] to find style inspiration, and created some concept art of our vision. Smoothly moving goods, soft curves and rich, vibrant colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/0af8109a7173bd3d7d0a65553487e203c700d33b.png[/img][i]above: early Star birds Concept Art, still using conveyor belts[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/3ababa23a4ba0aaeee9a31b112c6338f3161a28f.png[/img][i]above: later Concept Art with UI Design explorations and pipes only[/i]

[h3]
Transparent Pipes and Connector Designs 🔌[/h3]

We decided on a [b]transparent pipe material[/b] to clearly show the flow and direction of the pipe contents. This makes it easier for the player to navigate the overall production system. 

Ever been to a country with a different socket type than the one you are used to? Now imagine that situation in space. We neede to find a solution and prototyped different building connectors, carefully assessing their shape langauge and color, and tested feedback effects like rotating rings and flashing signal lights on the building itself. We ended up with a minimalistic connector design only on the pipe end, and a universal input-output ring on the buildings base. This makes it easy to quickly spot the connectors, grab and drag them, to ultimately connect them to a buildings IO-ring and ensure that your production network is running smoothly.

[h3]Free-Handed Pipe Dragging: Creativity Meets Strategy 🎨 [/h3]

The last and most important step was to make the gameplay feel wholesome and satisfying. We developed a free-handed pipe drawing mechanic, resulting in smooth curved paths like lines drawn with a brush. It' super easy to do, and feels a bit like dragging around a garden hose. We wanted it to feel espacially satisfying to interact with the irregular 3D asteroid surfaces while constructing your creations.

notes.title: Devlog: How We Create Buildings for Star Birds
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/6648768f35edf84d44310537e6e4577a2a414d6e.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

Today we'd love to talk a little about buildings in Star Birds, as they do play an important role in the game! As one of the core aspects of the game you will spend a lot of time with, we wanted to make sure they are looking as awesome as can be, while also not being static so your asteroids actually become lively little colonies all on their own.

[h2]So, How Did We Do That?[/h2]

[h3]Define the Style[/h3]
Well, we started out by defining a general style for the architecture. We were attracted by old kitchen appliances, especially those from the 80s and 90s, for their specific shape language.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/1b0f9594e7a83a0f0fb513f75bac352508e5774a.png[/img]

[h3]Figure Out What Is Important[/h3]
With the general looks locked in, the first step in adding a new building is to work out which elements are needed to truly make it work. For our mining drill, as an example, that meant having an actual drill, bucket-wheel-excavator, or another similar mining implement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/21b20506fcfe070a890656672ac754affd1795f3.png[/img]

[h3]Finding a Clear Design Language[/h3]
From there, our next thoughts were all about how a potential upgrade path could look like, starting with a very basic version of the drill and then going to more and more extravagant and busy designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/3880c6d016d8389b2f20a58651c6147526649845.png[/img]

[h3]Choose and Refine[/h3]
In the end, we took the drill concept, and simplified it! The drill now is the dominating element of the building, both in shape and animation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/8ebdfe63413fef8faa6fc11f5b150f061b1d7c1d.png[/img]

[h2]The Result[/h2]

Our final concept has the drill visibly moving up and down, spinning as if truly digging into the ground. This also allows for some very interesting movement all over an asteroid!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/3cdc24497fce70968924329b6cc45022f72ae015.gif[/img]

We hope this view behind the curtain was interesting! If you would like to see more from behind-the-scenes, sign up for our newsletter over on [url=http://star-birds.com/]our Website[/url]!
